_note: Curated family-travel guidance for the hackathon demo. Keyed by destination country (lowercase), plus a 'default'. Vetted static content — verify health/entry specifics with official sources before travel.

documents: Child's own passport (valid 6+ months) and visa if required
Copy of birth certificate showing parentage

health: Check routine childhood vaccinations are up to date before travel
Consider carrying a basic children's medicine kit; brands/labels may be unfamiliar locally
Air quality varies by city — check forecasts and consider masks for young children on high-pollution days
customs_and_practical: Baby formula and milk for the child are generally allowed in reasonable quantities for the trip
Carry documentation of any prescription medicines
Language barrier is significant — save your hotel address in Chinese characters
